--------
In this VladTV interview, John Franzese Jr. explains what happened immediately after he testified against his own father and entered the U.S. Marshals Witness Protection Program. Franzese says officials took and destroyed his phone, then struggled to place him safely because of his family’s wide-reaching Mafia connections, from New York ties to people as far away as Montana, comparing the challenge to cases involving Sammy “The Bull” Gravano. He describes temporary relocations, a first permanent stop in South Carolina, a security scare involving someone with gang ties, a brief move through North Carolina, and finally settling in Indianapolis under the name Matt Passerelle. Franzese also addresses a key misconception: he says he was not facing charges or cooperating to avoid prison time. Instead, he says he had become repulsed by the life and wanted out. The conversation covers loyalty, informants, family betrayal, and leaving organized crime.
